furniture.reason: The owner: the smaller crit rooms in the basement and on the second floor are similar to the ones on the third floor; the same interactions are enough for now. So every crit room gets what Level 3's got: pin-up felt on every opaque wall, a screen high on the short wall on the door's side (or the short opaque wall when the model has no door), and a projector facing it. Rooms that already have their own objects (Level 3's 1 and 4) are left as they are. Tables and chairs are not placed: their number is not known. Room 22 (Level 2, the large classroom that also serves as crit and pin-up space) is in the rule too (also_rooms). In room 22 the drop-down screen is on the wall opposite the window, the east wall (owner, 2026-11-06): screen_wall.
